claims.statement: Tom Allen ran a saloon in St. Louis called the Champion's Rest.
claims.excerpt: he was next heard of in the “Champion's Rest.”

claims.statement: Tom Allen let homeless men sleep by the fire in his saloon on cold winter nights and gave them breakfast after they cleaned up.
claims.excerpt: Next mornin’ they clean up short just for me and I give ‘em breakfast.

claims.statement: Tom Allen fled sheriffs and once left the country with John Law on his heels.
claims.excerpt: once left the country with John Law on his heels

claims.statement: Tom Allen fought Mike McCool on Foster's Island in June 1869; the fight ended in a draw after McCool's gang broke into the ring.
claims.excerpt: there was a draw. . McCool’s gang came into the ring and messed things up and the fight was off.

claims.statement: Charley Gallagher challenged the winner of the McCool fight; Allen said he would accept, and the match was set for Chouteau's Island two months later.
